scope: Conservative tensor-payload lower bound using the observed Slot routing as a counterfactual off workload; not measured link traffic or an attribution of runtime.
exclusions: Possible unused or duplicate prefetch assignments
proof: Relocating B token-expert pairs can reduce the number of cross-rank pairs by at most B. Thus C_slot >= C_off - B, whether or not borrowed work originated locally.
borrowed_work_exceeds_local_gate_cells_n: Nonzero count invalidates an assumption that all borrowed rows originated on their compute rank; it is not by itself a routing error.
assumptions: W4A8MXFP native ALLTOALL uses FP8 activation plus one e8m0 scale per32 values, then BF16 expert output.
MoonEP sends BF16 activation and BF16 expert output.
At least one full12.75MiB weight+scale payload is fetched per distinct remote expert with nonzero work; persistent cache and early prefetch are off.
Protocol metadata and local device memory traffic are not included.
